QUOTE: Doxygen itself reads only files matching `FILE_PATTERNS`. ... The in-scope set is also passed on as `scanned_files`, which lets the JS/TS front end register files doxygen will not read (cli.py:1747). ... `_drop_binary_files` non-text files removed (cli.py:1745, filetypes.py)
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the scope isn't the end: doxygen reads only matching patterns, the JS/TS front end claims files doxygen won't read, and `_drop_binary_files` removes non-text files.
